name: cherry-pr-test
tagline_zh: 合并前总怕翻车？这个技能自动拉取PR、跑UI测试、出报告，完事还帮你还原分支，连测试实例都清理干净。
tagline_en: Afraid to merge? This skill pulls PRs, runs UI tests via CDP, reports results, then cleans up and restores—all.
desc_en: Test Cherry Studio PRs by resolving and checking out a PR, statically inspecting its changes, running interactive UI tests against a safely tracked Electron instance through CDP, producing a structured report, cleaning up only the owned test instance, and restoring the original branch.
why_zh: 同类工具只测代码，它连Electron界面都真点一遍，且只清理自己创建的实例，不碰你其他环境。
why_en: Unlike static checkers, it drives the real Electron UI via CDP, and only removes its own test instance—zero collateral cleanup.
